relationships.subject: R-LysoPtdGlc
relationships.evidence_quote: R-LysoPtdGlc but not S-LysoPtdGlc increased behavioral sensitivity to mechanical stimuli, and that this response was dependent on GPR55

relationships.subject: S-LysoPtdGlc
relationships.evidence_quote: demonstrating that the biological activity of S-LysoPtdGlc is specifically mediated by Gpr55

relationships.subject: GPR55
relationships.evidence_quote: specific inhibition of GαS, but not Gα subunits Gα13, Gαq, and Gαi, abolished the chemoattractive response to S-LysoPtdGlc

relationships.subject: ML193
relationships.evidence_quote: chemoattraction induced by S-LysoPtdGlc was attenuated by pretreatment with ML193, a specific inhibitor of GPR55

key_findings: R-LysoPtdGlc causes GPR55-Gα13 chemorepulsion and GPR55-dependent mechanical hypersensitivity after intrathecal injection; S-LysoPtdGlc does not.
S-LysoPtdGlc induces chemoattraction via GPR55-GαS-adenylyl cyclase.
